problems.reason: Both claim different phylogenetic positions: 19 places Eotyrannus as a sister taxon to Proceratosauridae, distant from Megaraptora, while 21 states it is a megaraptorian closely related to Megaraptor.
Sentence 20 classifies Eotyrannus within Stokesosauridae, conflicting with the phylogenetic placements in 19 and 21.
The age ranges differ: 23 gives 125–120 Ma (Barremian), whereas 25 gives 132.6–121.4 Ma (Hauterivian to Barremian).

notes: - contradiction: "In 2024, Andrea Cau recovered Eotyrannus as a sister taxon to Proceratosauridae, distant from Megaraptora." / "A recent 2014 analysis by Porfiri et al. found that Eotyrannus is a megaraptorian closely related to taxa like Megaraptor.": Both claim different phylogenetic positions: 19 places Eotyrannus as a sister taxon to Proceratosauridae, distant from Megaraptora, while 21 states it is a megaraptorian closely related to Megaraptor.

- contradiction: "Eotyrannus lived in Europe during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 120 million years ago in the Barremian stage." / "Eotyrannus lived during the Hauterivian to Barremian stages, from 132.6 to 121.4 million years ago.": The age ranges differ: 23 gives 125–120 Ma (Barremian), whereas 25 gives 132.6–121.4 Ma (Hauterivian to Barremian).
